versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-dns-resolve-diagnose-customer v0.0.1

- Initial public release of a read-only Alibaba Cloud DNS diagnostic tool for end users.
- Supports troubleshooting DNS issues (e.g. resolution failure, unreachable domains, NXDOMAIN) on Alibaba Cloud DNS, GTM, PrivateZone, and third-party DNS.
- Performs WHOIS lookup, recursive tracing, Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI config checks, and nationwide probing via boce to generate reports.
- Strict read-only guarantee: all create, update, delete, or modify operations are refused, with standard refusal responses and cannot be bypassed.
- Clear instructions on environment setup, parameter confirmation, authentication, and required RAM permissions.
